answer: Lantern Ledger fingerprinting. Each agent writes a periodic signed state digest into a shared grove of append-only logs; honest agents produce digests whose update timing and entropy track their real workload. A duplicate identity cannot fake divergent digests without either copying the original (detectable as identical streams) or maintaining separate histories, which forces it to pay full compute and storage per clone. A trellis of cross-log consistency checks flags correlated timing as one operator. Cost: real resources per identity, no shared shortcut.
